Created a review manifest and checklist covering all 34 universities, 193 programs, and 454 existing official source records. The checklist exposes current unresolved fields and conflicts; all refresh outcomes remain pending until evidence is checked.

Rechecked 444 unique URLs across all 454 source records. 419 returned directly; 12 reached current official URLs after redirects; 11 of 13 TLS-inconclusive direct requests were independently retrieved in the content browser. Two remain inconclusive (a Camerino fee portal timeout and a 2022 Trieste PDF retrieval failure). No HTTP 404/410 outcomes. This is a reachability review, not a claim that every page supports every attributed field.

Extended the direct HTTP audit by checking two new official Statistical Science URLs; both returned HTTP 200. Current audit covers 547 unique URLs across 561 source records: 513 accessible, 13 redirected, 21 inconclusive and 0 confirmed broken. Twelve direct-HTTP inconclusive sources were separately opened and inspected through the official content fetcher: ten Camerino pages/PDFs, one Trieste historical catalogue PDF, and one Federico II Quantum Science and Engineering page. These retain their direct-HTTP inconclusive status but have separate accessible browser/content outcomes. Nine direct-inconclusive URLs still lack successful browser/content verification. Do not classify TLS errors or timeouts as dead links.

limitations: A homepage or admissions overview does not count as complete program research.
Program availability is counted as confirmed only when an official 2027/28 source names the degree and supports its level and language.
The historic tracker contained estimates and prior-cycle fees, deadlines, GPA labels, tiers and acceptance claims; these remain only in the archive and are not active facts.
No university is marked fully verified until its complete relevant BSc/MSc offer and the required fields have been checked program by program.
